subject: SIG package request + walkthrough scheduling and access plan
messages:
From: James Porter <security@helixbiotech.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sudhir Rao <sudhir@helixbiotech.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG package and walkthrough request

Hi Sergio,

We're in the middle of our vendor SIG collection for Q4 and would like to finish Helix's SIG for Redwood. Can you provide the completed SIG questionnaire and the supporting evidence (policies, diagrams, screenshots, runbooks) so our security team can close out their review?

Key asks:
- Completed SIG questionnaire (spreadsheet)
- Evidence items grouped by control (prefer a manifest CSV)
- Redacted screenshots for admin consoles and a network diagram
- A short live walkthrough (30-45 mins) to review evidence and ask clarifying questions

Ideal timeline: deliverables by Tue 15 Sep, walkthrough sometime next week. Please let us know if any items require a separate access request or manual redaction.

Attached: SIG_RFI_Template.xlsx (our template)

Thanks,
James Porter
Head of Information Security
Helix Biotech
security@helixbiotech.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <security@helixbiotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG package and walkthrough request

Hi James — thanks for the clear ask. We'll assemble the SIG deliverables and share a single Drive folder with an index manifest. Quick plan:

1) Manifest + completed SIG spreadsheet (CSV + Excel) — ETA: Mon 14 Sep EOD PT
2) Evidence by control (PDFs, screenshots, diagrams) — grouped inside the Drive folder; items requiring restricted access will be noted in the manifest
3) Live walkthrough: we can do Tue 15 Sep or Wed 16 Sep; proposed slot: Tue 14 Sep 18:00 UTC / Tue 15 Sep 11:00 PT — does that work?

I've looped in Marissa for sharing/access controls and Mina for the technical screenshots and runbooks. We'll redact any customer-specific data per your guidance; please confirm if we should remove internal hostnames entirely or replace them with placeholders.

Drive folder (preview): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aqz-Redwood-SIG-Helix-Shared
Preliminary manifest: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sig-manifest-v3

Attachments referenced for delivery: redwood_sig_manifest_v3.csv, host_inventory_snapshot.csv, network-diagram-helix.png (redacted)

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <security@helixbiotech.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG package and walkthrough request — access and redaction notes

Hi James,

We're pushing the initial bundle into the Drive folder now. A few operational notes:

- The folder has a manifest CSV (redwood_sig_manifest_v3.csv) that maps each evidence file to SIG control IDs.
- Some runbooks and the KMS runbook are sensitive; we've included sanitized extracts and flagged the originals as "restricted" in the manifest. If you need full originals, please request a VPN-backed session and we'll provision temporary access.
- For screenshots, we've redacted internal hostnames and replaced IPs with placeholders. If you prefer full-resolution images for audit, we can provide them during the walkthrough under NDA.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aqz-Redwood-SIG-Helix-Shared
Key files in folder (high level):
- completed_sig_2026Q3.xlsx
- redwood_sig_manifest_v3.csv
- network-diagram-helix.png (redacted)
- kms_runbook_v2.pdf (sanitized excerpt)
- host_inventory_snapshot.csv (hashes removed)

Attaching the manifest as well to this thread for your immediate review.

Marissa Cole
Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: James Porter <security@helixbiotech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sudhir Rao <sudhir@helixbiotech.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG package and walkthrough request — confirm items and timing

Thanks — confirm we can access the Drive folder (viewer). A couple follow-ups:

- Can you include a screenshot of the NAT translation table (redacted) and a sample session trace showing KV cache expiry behavior? Those are specifically called out by our network team.
- Please enable viewer access for Sudhir (sudhir@helixbiotech.com) — he's the one who will attend from our infra team.
- We need the walkthrough on Tue 15 Sep but moved an hour earlier to 10:00 PT; attendees will be James, Sudhir, and our procurement lead (Tina). Please send a calendar invite.

Also — is there any cost for providing unredacted artifacts during an on-site or VPN session? If so, include the cost estimate.

Thanks,
James
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <security@helixbiotech.com>, Sudhir Rao <sudhir@helixbiotech.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG package and walkthrough request — updated assets and calendar invite

Hi James / Sudhir —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I've added the NAT screenshot and a brief KV-cache behavior snapshot (png) to the folder and adjusted share settings so Sudhir has Viewer access. Links below:

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aqz-Redwood-SIG-Helix-Shared
Direct files added: network-nat-table-redacted.png, kv-cache-sample.png

Per Marissa's note: full originals require a controlled session. If Helix wants full-resolution originals we can arrange a VPN-backed review or an on-prem session; there may be an admin effort charge (estimate: $1,200 for provisioning and redaction review) — let us know and we'll raise a PO.

I've also created the calendar invite for Tue, 15 Sep 2026 at 10:00 PT — you should have received a Google Calendar invite from me (if not, I'll resend).

Best,
Mina Haddad
